decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Details of external brickwork, pointing, mortar, and bonding shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects. The existing chimney pots shall be retained and re-instated on the chimneys.
Condition : 4 - The roof tiles should be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 4 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
description: Replacement of the concrete roof & cladding tiles with clay tiles, removal of render from chimney stacks and repairing
